manifest.rationale: Third and final preregistered geometry-matched random-retention control, seed 105706. Reconstructed from W0; /work/round14_provenance.json and /work/geometry_control_plan.json.

report.causal_tests: Temporary last-token removal of L34 channel 1057 changed a zebra 1-minus-0 margin from +0.5 to -0.25 without repairing harder tennis-ball or laptop failures. Static full-column ablation reproduced the two target zebra repairs. Thirty distinct static candidates covered dose, decomposition, transfer, random-direction, matched-geometry, attention-head and pair tests. Full L23 ablation caused three total-count regressions. Fixed L23+L32, L23+L34 and L32+L34 ablations achieved 323/464, 322/464 and 325/464 correct answers. Their fixed 13-prompt panels reproduced evaluated answers and passed ordering checks. No path-specific restoration or edge intervention tested serial mediation.
report.counterevidence: Removing only L34 column 1057's proposed zero-aligned projection did not reproduce the two zebra repairs; retaining it while removing the orthogonal component did. All three geometry-matched random-retention controls reproduced both zebra repairs officially; the selected candidate is one of them. Generic attenuation is therefore a plausible alternative to a special retained direction. Transfer controls lacked critical-case activity matching, and random-delta controls did not match new-column norm. One approximately norm/write-matched head-24 control did not reproduce the zebra targets, but this does not establish unique spatial functionality for head 13. Correct-one controls were also affected, sometimes with increased one-versus-zero margins. The wrong-three case and harder failures were not generally repaired. L32 half-ablation and head-13 projection removal had evaluation/repeat discrepancies. W0 itself changed its umbrella answer from evaluated 4 to repeated 3 with a measured tie; apparent umbrella repairs are not secure causal evidence.
report.evaluation: Selected accuracy is 322/464 versus W0 320/464: two corrections, zero regressions, one additional wrong-to-wrong change. Repair score is 56/116 versus 55/116; primary T0 joint correctness remains 27/58. Both corrections, B-10840:subset:T1:B0 and B-3805:subset:T1:B1, were 1-to-0 for gold 0 and repeated. The candidate matched 13/15 audited official answers and W0 matched 14/15. Candidate B-188190 changed from evaluated 2 to repeated 1, both wrong for gold 4; the other discrepancy was the umbrella case. All 30 full evaluations had zero format errors and zero truncations. Round 30 achieved 325/464 but tied on repair score and was not selected. Automatic selection was preserved without diagnostic rescoring.

report.failure_behavior: Some spatial-subset answers fail despite correct total counts and depend on same-image wording. W0 answers B-538866 total/T0/B0 correctly as 1 but subset/T0/B0 incorrectly as 1 for gold 0; subset/T1/B0 answers 0. B-10840 subset/T1/B0 answers 1 for gold 0, whereas T0/B0 answers 0. Errors also include a laptop answer of 1 for gold 2 and a wrong-three strawberry case. Universal omission of spatial conditions is not established.
report.internal_evidence: Last-prompt-token activations and digit logits nominated L23 MLP column 3537, L32 MLP column 619, L34 MLP column 1057, and L24 attention head-13 output block. Failure/success contrasts remained confounded by prompt form and numerical answer. W0 L34 channel-1057 activity was 14.4375 versus 4.3125 for wrong-one/correct-zero tennis variants and 11.875 versus 4.6875 for zebra variants. Correct-one controls also had high activity, 22.125 and 29.875; the wrong-three strawberry case had activity approximately 0.0109253. Selected-candidate zebra 1-minus-0 margins changed from +0.5 to 0 and +0.25 to -0.25; both repeated generations were 0, but the first margin is tied. Input/chat hashes and expected upstream invariance were verified. Sources: actions 0012–0019, 0082, 0173–0175.
report.limitations: The 464 prompts are correlated within 58 image groups. Thirty development comparisons, a small selected gain, BF16 ties and documented repeat discrepancies limit inference. Last-prompt-token states are not object-specific spatial variables. Controls were imperfectly matched; head edits were much larger than single-column MLP edits. Implementation checks do not establish mechanistic specificity or generalization.
report.negative_findings: No shared spatial-success representation, uniquely necessary zero-aligned component, or general spatial-reasoning repair was established. Repair overlap, downstream activation changes and pair nonadditivity do not establish serial mediation. Negative and inconsistent findings are retained in the full ledger rather than treating every answer change as a repair.

report.repair_rationale: Test whether attenuating a localized channel's output reduces small wrong-one versus zero margins, while examining rival direction-specific explanations. The selected edit is a random-retention control, not a validated spatial-direction edit. It is retained because the harness selected it under the fixed development criterion.
report.scope: Branch B, development split D only: 58 image groups and 464 correlated prompts crossing total/subset counting, T0/T1 wording and B0/B1 prompting. All 30 distinct repair candidates were evaluated on this same development set; automatic selection used its fixed repair criterion. Localization and diagnostic panels were also drawn from seen development data. No held-out validation, branch-C evaluation or generalization test was performed. Last-prompt-token measurements concern text-position activations, while static weight edits apply at all positions. Conclusions are restricted to local numerical-output effects in the tested model and prompts.
report.verdict: Local causal influence on context-dependent numerical-answer competition is supported, and the selected candidate has a small official seen-development improvement. A shared spatial-success representation, uniquely necessary zero-aligned component, serial spatial circuit, and generalizable spatial-reasoning repair remain unsupported. Generic attenuation is a plausible explanation, not an established universal mechanism. Automatic selection is preserved despite these limitations.
